draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: On the unseen test set of the trained Banking and Travel domains, Wrenfold outperforms Fennick-Base in macro-F1 (93.1 vs 91.6 on Banking; 92.4 vs 90.9 on Travel).
rationale: The evidence only covers the unseen test set of the two trained domains (Banking, Travel). No evaluation on domains not seen in training exists, so the generalization claim is unsupported; the supported claim is the within-domain advantage.
